subject.title: [Bug]: Official ClawHub WhatsApp plugin cannot start linked account due to openKeyedStore trust check

question: May OpenClaw treat a recorded official ClawHub install discovered as workspace-origin as trusted when package id, official catalog identity, install record, and resolved install path all match?
rationale: That predicate decides which external plugin code receives trusted persistent state and channel ingress APIs, so automation should not choose it without maintainer security intent.

options.title: Approve Narrow Provenance Fix
options.body: Allow a focused repair for official ClawHub installs only when catalog identity, install record, and resolved path agree, while keeping raw workspace and allowlist-only plugins untrusted.

options.title: Hold For Broader Trust Design
options.body: Leave this blocked until the wider external-plugin trust model covers official installs, immutable images, and local provenance together.

options.title: Reject Workspace-Origin Trusted State
options.body: Keep all workspace-origin plugins denied trusted state even when an official ClawHub install record exists, accepting that this WhatsApp install shape remains unusable.

recommendation.title: Approve Narrow Provenance Fix
recommendation.body: Allow a focused repair for official ClawHub installs only when catalog identity, install record, and resolved path agree, while keeping raw workspace and allowlist-only plugins untrusted.

likelyOwner.reason: They have recent adjacent trust-boundary work and already gave maintainer-side policy guidance for external channel plugin provenance.
